facts.value: Decodes a four-word stage_sfx command, selects direction from 0, 1, -1 or facing_dir for pitch selectors 0–3, and passes the requested ID through ft_80087D0C. Destinations 0–6 may call lbAudioAx_800263E8 followed by lbAudioAx_800264E4 and store the result in the selected Fighter field. Destinations 2 and 6 suppress that call path when x2225_b6 is set except for GameWatch and Samus; unsupported destinations make no handle write.
